verdict.description: confirmed (survived refutation, artifact in hand) | debunked (refuted) | unverified (survives but not demonstrable here)

reason.description: one line: debunked — what refuted it; unverified — the concrete missing precondition; confirmed — the decisive artifact

probe.description: ACDSL repos: the probe rule id that decided the verdict, or "none: <why unprobeable after 2 attempts>"; "manual: <kind>" otherwise

script.description: the probe executable, path relative to the round's probes/ dir — absent on the manual path

fixture.description: the minimal fail fixture the probe went RED on in the validity check, path under the round dir — absent on the manual path

registry.description: the probe's merged registry, path relative to the round's probes/ dir — absent on the manual path

effect.description: confirmed only, optional: the refuter's own answer when it differs from the candidate's

verdict_path.description: absolute path of round-{r}/verdicts/<finding-slug>.json — the full verdict with evidence (what was run/read, decisive lines) and artifacts (absolute paths written under the round dir)

evidence.description: returned verdict only, one string: the verdict file's decisive line — its evidence.probe_run, else its first evidence.read entry
